action_items: FIX (HIGH): Remove/guard the auto-select-first effect in Components/UI/CompanySelector/index.tsx (~line 118: `if (active == null && companies.length > 0) companyState.selectCompany(companies[0].company_id)`). It races CompanyDataContext's restore-from-localStorage effect and, because companyList is newest-first, it overwrites the persisted last_company_id (LS + backend PUT) on every load. Let CompanyDataContext own the default selection, or only auto-select when getLastCompanyId() is null/invalid.
Enlarge the mobile company-selector trigger hit area to >=44px to match the rest of the ITEM 3 work.
Make the mobile invoice preview overlay closeable with Escape and add a loading state for the PDF frame (blank black area for several seconds).
Fix the DialogTitle Typography nesting warning in Customers detail dialog.

rca_of_the_issue: Company-switch persistence bug: contexts/CompanyDataContext.tsx restores the persisted company from localStorage 'last_company_id' in an effect that runs after companyList resolves, while Components/UI/CompanySelector/index.tsx has its own effect that runs while selectedCompanyId is still null and calls selectCompany(companies[0].company_id). companyList comes back newest-first, so companies[0] is the newly created QA-DELETE-ME (55); selectCompany writes 55 to localStorage AND PUTs it to /api/user/last-company, permanently overwriting the user's real choice. Reproduction: with 2 companies, switch to hostbay (label + toast OK, LS=1, PUT 200 with 1), then reload or hard-navigate -> label reverts to QA-DELETE-ME, LS=55, an unsolicited PUT 55 is observed, and hostbay-scoped data (7 invoices) renders as an empty state. Mitigation: single source of truth for the default company selection.
